Here is the provided context, which appears to describe the timeline of the Digital Personal Data Protection Bill in India:

"The Digital Personal Data Protection Bill, 2022 was released for public consultation on 18 November 2022 by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. The cabinet approved the revised version of the bill, the Digital Personal Data Protection Bill, 2023, on 5 July 2023. The bill was introduced in Lok Sabha on 3 August 2023 and passed by the lower house on 7 August 2023. The Digital Personal Data Protection Bill, 2023 was introduced and passed by Rajya Sabha on 9 August 2023. On 11 August 2023, the President of India gave assent to the bill."

It is worth noting that the bill is described as being the first Act of the Parliament of India to use "she/her" pronouns instead of the usual "he/him" pronouns.
